ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-contrast low-intensity (black) pixels restricted to the trailing edge boundary and central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous high-intensity white field across both primary lobes; low-intensity black contiguous banding along the trailing edge topography; small dark focal cluster at the inferior center near the peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 62 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels; density of serrations increases from the median notch toward the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral symmetrical concave curve originating from the notch, transitioning to an upward convex sweep at the distal lobe terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple (approx. 20-30) discrete, circular high-intensity white pixel clusters scattered primarily across the distal thirds of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of hyper-intense white/grey calcified formations (barnacle colonization) concentrated heavily on the extreme distal tips and intermittently along the black trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Small vertical dark streak (approx. 20 pixels in height) located on the lower central portion of the right lobe near the fluke base.
